title: IRCC: Visitor visa (temporary resident visa) online application
before: Sign in to the IRCC portal (or create an account), answer the eligibility questions, and it builds your list of forms and uploads.
IRCC dates are year-month-day. The dates below are already in that order.
You'll pay CAN$100 for the visa and CAN$85 for biometrics online at the end.

sections.title: Personal details
yourself: Previous countries of residence in the last five years

sections.title: Marital status
yourself: Spouse or partner's name and date of marriage, if any

sections.title: Languages
yourself: Native language and whether you can communicate in English or French

sections.title: Passport
yourself: National identity document, if you have one

sections.title: Education
yourself: School name, field of study and years attended

sections.title: Employment
yourself: Your past 10 years of activity, with no gaps

sections.title: Background information

fields.label: Ever refused a visa or permit, or entry to Canada or another country

yourself: Health, criminal record, military service and other background questions

after: Upload your passport, photo, financial proof, travel plans and any invitation letter, then pay CAN$100 plus CAN$85 for biometrics.
Give your fingerprints and photo at a visa application centre within 30 days of the biometrics instruction letter.
If approved, IRCC asks for your passport to place the visa in it. Record the decision on your dashboard.
